notes.title: 🏳️‍🌈 Pride Month 🏳️‍🌈
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

In celebration of Pride Month I have discounted the price for the Steam version of the Endless Empty starting tomorrow (6/7/2019).

As always, sales of the game are being donated to the Trevor Project. To show my love for all LGBTQ+ people this month I will match all sales (up to $150) from 6/7/2019 to 7/7/2019 with a second, personal donation to the Trevor Project.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/2fa19ad19a859894145944db219f67f860a2d6e3.png[/img]


Thank you for your continued support. I know I have been quiet here for awhile, I have been working hard on my next game project. 
Feel free to say hello to me on twitter https://twitter.com/ErikSheader or Instagram https://www.instagram.com/erik_sheader/ ❤️💛💚💙💜

notes.title: Update 1/25/2019
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.

I just uploaded a new build of the Endless Empty. This update includes more balanced bosses, items, the ability to sell things in the tranquility rooms as well as a few more minor fixes. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/ca74960677b92a255abc140b5b245979c48bf218.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/77b3c91456ccc687eb1c5ad04aac876e26e91fc0.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/1a2109ed9fdb19d0576bd42911f63bc18602111c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/1435947f96ae1b59e9867cc28a9acfb426df9fdb.png[/img][/url]

Thanks to your purchases and the help of my friends over in 1 of 1 gaming, the Endless Empty has now raised over $1000 for the Trevor Project.

I really appreciate all the messages, fan arts, streams and youtube coverage everyone has provided for this game. If you haven't done so already I would be infinitely grateful if you dropped a review here on steam, as it helps the game's visibility on the platform.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/4375b7e28c88236c6b767d5408b271112b0d46c5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/6c6ce3648e44769f83acc1dc18fa9198397753e2.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/822430a6dc8091ed60e84004a9a6bc02ae18ebf9.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/da6770843b53adaa838aba42e4a348228ffc8eda.png[/img][/url]

And as a final update: at this moment I'm in the early stages of putting together my second game project and hope to be able to share information on that real soon.

As always you can contact me at the following places.

https://twitter.com/ErikSheader

https://www.facebook.com/SugarySweetMachines/

https://www.instagram.com/Erik_Sheader/?hl=en

notes.title: I would love to hear from you / Donation Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody

The Endless Empty has been out for a month and I just want to express my gratitude to everyone who has played, sent me fanart, sent me comments or has streamed the game. At this time I am currently practicing my skills in an attempt to become a better programmer, game designer, writer and artist. You can help me out. I would love to hear from you! Whether it be a review here on stream, or contacting me on [url=https://www.facebook.com/SugarySweetMachines/]facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/ErikSheader]twitter[/url], your comments are greatly appreciated. I will be taking any critiques to heart as I continue to improve The Endless Empty, and while I work on future projects.

I also wanted to update everyone on the donations from game sales. All funds I receive from  the Endless Empty here on steam and itch.io will be donated to the Trevor Project. I do have to wait a month for Steam's payouts, but thanks to you The Endless Empty has now raised over $300 for charity. You are awesome.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/a5e76a92a4585901d895b569099ab72cabe0a7f6.png[/img]
